title: Austin's New Commercial Zones & Street Rules
summary:
*   **Street Use Regulations Amended:** Rules governing street usage for the Scarbrough Building contractor were updated, incorporating recommendations from the city's Building Inspector and Traffic Department.
*   **Commercial Zoning Approved (Waller Blvd/26th St):** A property at the intersection of the proposed Waller Boulevard and 26th Street was rezoned for Commercial "C" use.
*   **Commercial Zoning with Condition (East 15th/East Ave):** Another property at East 15th Street and East Avenue was also rezoned to Commercial "C," with the specific requirement that any new building built there must front East 15th Street.

SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, March 6, 1931,
The Council was called to order at 8:00 P. M. by the Mayor. Roll call showed the following
members present: Mayor McFadden, Councilmen Pannell, Reed, and Steck, 4; absent,
Councilman Mueller, 1.
Councilman Pannell moved that the certain ordinance passed on March 5, 1931, granting to
James F. Taylor, Contractor for the Scarbrough Building, the use of certain streets be
amended in accordance with the recommendations of the Building Inspector and the Traffic
Department, and that the City Attorney be directed to prepare such amendment. Motion was
seconded by Councilman Steok and same prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor
McFadden, Councilmen Pannell, Reed, and Steck, 4; nays, none, Councilman Mueller absent,
1.
The Mayor stated that the Council would take up for consideration the requests of certain
citizens for changes in the zoning map.
Mayor MoFadden moved that the property owned by D. B. Barrow and M. L. Pearson, known as
Lots 72 and 73, in the South one-half of Outlot No. I, Division "X", at the intersection
of the proposed Waller Boulevard and Twenty-sixth Street, be placed in Commercial "C" Use
District. Motion was seconded by Councilman Pannell, and same prevailed by the following
vote: Ayes, Mayor MoFadden, Councilmen Pannell, Reed, and Steck, 4; nays, none; Councilman
Mueller absent, 1.
Mayor MoFadden moved that Lot No. 6, Block 68, at the northwest corner intersection of
East Fifteenth Street and East Avenue, owned by Mrs. T. A. Stromquist, be placed in
Commercial "C" Use District, provided that any building that may be erected thereon shall
front on East Fifteenth Street. Motion was seconded by Councilman Pannell, and same
prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor McFadden, Councilmen Pannell, Reed, and
Steck, 4; nays, none, Councilman Mueller absent, 1.
Councilman Reed moved that the Council recess, subject to call of the Mayor. Motion was
seconded by Mayor McFadden and same prevailed by the following vote: Ayes, Mayar McFadden,
Councilmen Funnell, Reed, and Steck, 4; nays, none; Councilman Mueller absent.
The Council then recessed.
AZUROVED, IWM Fadden
